property1_bugCondition.rootCause: Collect had no capability gate and Source carried no enabled-capability data, so every catalog table was queried regardless of the connection's granted capabilities.

1.summary: Wrote bug-condition exploration test with a recording query layer. Confirmed it FAILS on unfixed code (5 counterexamples), proving the collector queries ungranted-capability tables.

2.summary: Wrote 5 preservation property tests (core always queried, enabled gated table queried, ungated always queried, no-gating fallback, error isolation/continuation). All PASS on unfixed code, establishing the baseline to preserve.

3.1.summary: TableSpec.Capability (yaml:"capability") documented; Catalog.Validate() left unchanged (empty = ungated). Annotated all 13 aws.yaml tables: core(7), eks(1), workload(3), ai(2); no table maps to dspm.

3.2.summary: aws/adapter.Discover now sets cfg["capabilities"] = t.Capabilities so the DiscoveryPlan's SteampipeConfig carries the connection's enabled capability set to Factory.

3.3.summary: Added Source.enabledCaps, capsFromConfig ([]string/[]any), capsToSet (always adds core; nil/empty = no gating), capabilityEnabled helper, and the gate `if !s.capabilityEnabled(spec.Capability) { continue }` in Collect. Factory reads the capabilities config key.

3.4.summary: Unit tests: capabilityEnabled (9 cases), capsToSet, capsFromConfig, Collect gate skip/query, Factory wiring ([]string/[]any/missing), and aws.yaml capability validity against the known capability set.

3.5.summary: Re-ran the task-1 bug-condition test unchanged; it now PASSES, confirming ungranted-capability tables are skipped (no query, no AccessDenied).

3.6.summary: Re-ran the task-2 preservation tests unchanged; all 5 still PASS, confirming no regression.

4.summary: End-to-end integration tests through adapter.Discover -> steampipe.Factory -> Collect: core+eks queries core/eks tables and skips workload/ai; nil capabilities collects every catalog table (back-compat).

5.summary: Checkpoint: go build ./..., go vet ./..., and go test ./... all clean across the module (including internal/source/steampipe, internal/connector/capability, internal/connector/provider/aws).
